requirements.text: 7+ years of hands-on software development experience with a primary focus on customizing, building, and deploying AOSP at the platform/OS layer.
Proven track record in the architecture, design, and customization of Android devices and platforms (frameworks/base, SystemServer, JNI, AIDL/HIDL) rather than consumer applications.
Technical proficiency in at least two major languages used in the AOSP stack: Java, C++, C, or Kotlin.
Hands-on experience adapting Android frameworks, system services, and Hardware Abstraction Layers (HAL).
Proficient with AOSP build tools and revision control workflows, including Git, Gerrit, repo, Android.bp, and Android.mk.
Deep understanding of platform security protocols, encryption/decryption, PKI certificate management, and Hardware Security Modules (HSM).
Hands-on experience with Android HAL development or Project Treble architecture.
Experience working directly with the Linux Kernel for Android, device drivers, or ARM TrustZone / TEE environments.
Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers, driving architecture reviews, and providing technical leadership to cross-functional teams.
